name: context-handoff
description: Hands a long session off cleanly: at a context threshold Claude updates the docs and writes a handoff, the session compacts with its instructions, then a kickoff prompt carries on. Gives Claude a live context reading and a /wrap-up skill

threshold.title: Handoff threshold (%)
threshold.description: How full the context window gets (%) before the handoff starts; /handoff 60 sets it too

mode.title: Handoff mode
mode.description: auto runs the handoff itself; ask puts the handoff prompt in the prompt box for you to send; off only shows Claude the reading

handoffPath.title: Handoff file
handoffPath.description: Where the wrap-up skill writes the handoff, relative to the project root
